newsitem.title: USA: Democrat Baucus retains Senate seat in Montana.
newsitem.headline: Democrat Baucus retains Senate seat in Montana.

text.p: Democrat Max Baucus held on to his Montana Senate seat after fending off a strong Republican challenge, the ABC television network said Tuesday.

Baucus, an 18-year veteran of the Senate and a senior member of the powerful Finance Committee who specializes in trade issues, defeated Republican Lt. Gov. Dennis Rehberg in a campaign in which he was attacked for "liberal" votes, including on abortion. Baucus defended what he called an independent record.
